The '''domesticated mynock''' was a variant of the [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Domesticated mynocks were used by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Chorssk]] as weapons against [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020425amynocks&c=rpg|text=Domesticated Mynocks}}</ref>
